case: English Wikipedia temporary accounts and the routine task of investigating potentially abusive edits
unit_of_reading: One workflow and linked public decisions, implementation and follow-up. Survey outcomes and log outcomes refer to different observational units.

records.roles: Foundation Trust & Safety Product team sets the proposed baseline enforcement. Stewards may grant qualifying exceptions.
records.support: The recorded rule keeps an exception path. Repeated overrides were named as a possible reason to reconsider the rule.
records.unknown: Whether exceptions accumulated or later changed the policy.

records.roles: Engineering and operations implement configuration. A team tester reports localhost checks of the threshold change.
records.scope: May 22 and 31, 2025. English Wikipedia deployment November 4, 2025 UTC.
records.support: Threshold backport and site-specific feature deployment have different dated operations records.
records.unknown: First live use, and whether all variants of the permissions path worked for all roles.

records.roles: Applicant submits the request and opts in after a grant. A local administrator assesses demonstrated need and suitability. A steward is the route for exceptions to Foundation minimums.
records.scope: Later Foundation and local policy snapshots
records.support: Policy gives a formal access path and distinguishes discretion over local need from the power to waive a minimum.
records.unknown: An individual grant, refusal, transfer, wait, or frequency. The policy snapshots postdate feature deployment.

records.roles: An eligible user can invoke the February view from contributions. A shared IP can connect records across temporary accounts.
records.support: The team describes a restricted route for grouping edit history. The IP association supplies a clue.
records.unknown: Whether the same individual used the accounts, whether conduct was abusive, and effects on work or error.

records.roles: Volunteer respondents in the Foundation’s two English Wikipedia recruitment pools.
records.support: Open-text accounts describe both extra tracing and improvements in finding connections. Tool use and effort were self-reported. The page 6 totals conflict, and the report documents self-report error on an unavailable route.
records.unknown: Total labor, representative prevalence, actual tool usage, and change from a measured baseline.

records.task: Measure visible report and closure events
records.roles: Foundation research team analyzes filing and case closure and tracks volume in another monitoring venue.
records.support: The summary reports no defensible attribution of case duration to rollout and no increased report rate in the other venue based on its analysis.
records.unknown: Pre-filing work, time actively handling a case, wait by role, and causal effects.

proposed_observation.status: proposed for discussion; independent source and method review pending
context: actor's permitted access at the time
handoff: role that can grant or override
stage and when the clock starts
outcomes: resolved or unresolved status with scope
privacy and error outcomes where observed
proposed_observation.observational_limit: No actual IP address, contributor identifier or private case is included. Nonpublic reveal logs were not inspected.
